messages:
Evan Park: Heads-up 10m PT : Lighthouse Health wants a small POC to swap from LighthouseAPI to Redwood. Must match streaming frames exactly, keep token accounting parity, FHIR passthrough, EU-only processing, and sign DPA + SOC2 confirmation. Target: 3-week trial. Who can run tech lead?
Lina Torres: I can lead the engineering side. Need Lighthouse sample requests/responses (esp streaming frames) and their rate-limit rules.
Marcus Doyle: Sales ask  client asks for migration credit and a short-term price parity guarantee. Suggest 30% credit for first 60 days + review. Also need quota alignment for per-customer limits.
Sanjay Rao: I'll provision a Dedicated eu-west slice and pin rdx-3.0-small for the POC. Will tune batching to hit their P95 latency.
ComplianceBot: Security summary: SOC2 Type II present. KMS options: AWS KMS, GCP CMEK, or customer HSM on Private. Private control plane supports EU-only processing. DPA and completed questionnaire required; will need DPO contact.
Evan Park: Blocker  Lighthouse uses a custom SSE pattern: events named "chunk", "info", "eof". Their client treats "info" frames as stateful (contains provenance). Must preserve field names and ordering.
Lina Torres: I'll implement a Lighthouse-compatible facade that proxies Redwood responses and emits identical SSE events. Will also mirror headers like X-Org-Role and X-Client-Token. Example test curl:```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST \
  https://poc.redwood.local/lighthouse/v1/stream \
  -d '{"prompt":"<redacted>","stream":true}'
```
Lina Torres: SSE shim sketch:```js
// Lighthouse-style SSE frames
res.write('data: ' + JSON.stringify({chunk: token_piece}) + "\\n\\n");
res.write('event: info\\n' + 'data: ' + JSON.stringify({source: 'rdx', provenance: p}) + "\\n\\n");
res.write('event: eof\\n' + 'data: {}' + "\\n\\n");
```
Marcus Doyle: Evaluation metrics they requested: token-cost delta, latency P50/P95, intent F1 on 500 labeled clinical prompts, and hallucination incidents. They'll accept <2% regression on critical intents.
Sanjay Rao: Plan: A/B harness between Lighthouse and Redwood-shim. Need 500 labeled prompts + ~2k corpus. I'll coordinate infra and run comparison snapshots.
Evan Park: Legal wants a rollback plan if regressions exceed threshold. Proposal: canary route 10% traffic for 48h with automatic fallback to Lighthouse on regression signal. Also need SLA language for POC.
legal-bot: We'll draft DPA addendum and short POC SLA. Need Mediator contact for legal and expected retention (they asked 24 months audit logs).
ComplianceBot: 24-month immutable logs supported on Private with DPA addendum. EU residency confirmed for eu-west deployment.
Lina Torres: Action list: 1) build endpoint shim & header passthrough, 2) implement SSE emitter with exact event labels, 3) mirror Lighthouse rate limits in shim, 4) run smoke tests with Sanjay, 5) produce diff report.
Marcus Doyle: I'll prepare pricing proposal and migration credit terms and post by tomorrow EOD.
Sanjay Rao: Infra queued. ETA 48h for Dedicated slice (ticket #40122).
Evan Park: Ok to schedule kickoff with Lighthouse Health for Monday 09:00 CET unless objections. I'll consolidate this thread as the SOT for the POC.
Lina Torres: No objections. I'll grab sample frames today and start the shim.
Marcus Doyle: Will attach the pricing draft and migration credit details here when ready. :thumbsup:
legal-bot: Reminder: upload completed security questionnaire + DPO contact.
Evan Park: Thanks team 1 marking this thread as the canonical POC thread. I'll update with artifacts as they arrive.
